hero.headline: Turn a body of work into a system that can remember, disagree, mature, and repair itself.
hero.support: A research-operations method for transforming notes, documents, conversations, models, experiments, and revisions into a traceable corpus with provenance, claim status, contradiction handling, review gates, and replacement history.

sections.heading: Preserve the source
sections.body: Ingestion begins by retaining provenance and source boundaries so later synthesis remains reconstructible.

sections.heading: Extract candidate structure
sections.body: Claims, concepts, artifacts, dependencies, contradictions, evidence, and open questions become explicit objects rather than remaining buried in prose.

sections.heading: Keep maturity visible
sections.body: A note, hypothesis, working result, reviewed artifact, and public claim are different states and should not silently collapse into one another.

sections.heading: Record replacement
sections.body: Knowledge systems need supersession and correction paths so improvement does not erase why a prior representation existed.

sections.heading: Human promotion gates
sections.body: AI and automation may accelerate transformation, but consequential promotion into the durable corpus remains reviewable and attributable.

relationship.workbench: Corpus Forge Workbench is the maintained software/product expression of this method and program.
relationship.ledger: Claim and Evidence Ledger is a focused product surface extracted from the wider governance model.
